persona.title: Initial research plan
persona.purpose: Turn a broad topic into bounded research with an explicit in/out list and a sufficiency rule you can test.
persona.when: you need to understand a new topic before deciding or producing, and have no base built yet.
persona.example: Generative AI applied to my sales work, before choosing what to train in.
persona.evidence: in/out scope list, essential questions, priority sources filtered by validity and region, named tensions and a testable sufficiency rule.
persona.prompt: I need to understand <TOPIC>. The decision at stake is <DECISION>. My context is <CONTEXT>. Bound the scope with an explicit in/out list; frame the essential questions; separate facts, interpretations and uncertainty. Prioritize primary sources with author, date, link and reason, filtered by validity within <HORIZON> and applicability in <REGION>; if those two constraints clash, ask me which one wins before continuing. Name the tensions between positions and the open gaps, and flag my risk of deciding on an incomplete base. If the topic is already narrow, validate the cut instead of narrowing it again. If no primary sources exist, declare coverage_gap and stop. Close with one testable sufficiency rule: a question I can answer for <AUDIENCE> without adjectives. Do not invent sources or certainty.
